# Town of Duxbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists four Duxbury Selectboard members: Patrick Zachary (Chair), Mari Pratt (Vice Chair), Gwenna Peters, and Matt Schroeder.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists FIVE members, adding Jamison Ervin (3-year term expiring 2026); the official 2026 tally records Mari Pratt (258 votes) and Matt Schroeder (286) elected to 1-year terms and Gwenna Peters (285) elected to the remaining two years of her term, and NO winner for the 3-year seat (write-ins did not reach the required 12 votes). Schroeder and Peters had been serving as appointees and are recorded as elected on the 2026 tally.

Town of Duxbury Selectboard page (duxburyvermont.org, current): the current roster seats Zachary (Chair, term expiring 2027), Pratt (Vice Chair), Schroeder, and Peters, and posts the fifth seat as Vacant. Ervin is not recorded.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the official 2026 tally records Daniel Senning re-elected Moderator (306 votes); the report's table prints 'Dan Senning'.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists Maureen Harvey as Town Clerk, elected to a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Maureen Harvey as Town Clerk of Duxbury.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists Maureen Harvey as Town Treasurer, elected to a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Maureen Harvey as Town Treasurer of Duxbury.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists the Delinquent Tax Collector as an ELECTED office held by Maureen Harvey (3-year term expiring 2027).

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists Alan Quackenbush (term expiring 2026), Max Popowicz (2027), and Mo LaVarnway (2028) as Listers; the official 2026 tally records Quackenbush re-elected (290 votes).

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists the town-elected Budget Committee on 5-year terms: Ben MacKinney (resigned), Ann Harvey (expiring 2027), Mari Pratt (2028), Jill Smith (2029), and Brenda Clarkson (appointed in 2025, expiring 2030); the official 2026 tally records no winner for either Budget Committee seat that stood in 2026. MacKinney, having resigned, is not recorded.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's Elected Offices table lists Jessica Engels (term expiring 2026), Dwight Day (2027), and Naomi Alfini (2028) as Cemetery Commissioners; the official 2026 tally records Engels re-elected (293 votes).

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the official 2026 tally records Eric Potter re-elected 1st Constable (300 votes, 2-year term).

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the official 2026 tally records James L. Welch re-elected 2nd Constable (302 votes, 2-year term); the report's table prints 'James Welch'.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Duxbury justices of the peace: Greg Trulson, Maurice Lavanway, Shawn Perry, Dan Cardozo, Jill Smith, Lori Morse, and Cindy Senning.

Town of Duxbury 'Annual Election Report 2025' and 'Duxbury 2026 Town Meeting Tally' (March 3, 2026), reached through the Town Clerk and Treasurer page (duxburyvermont.org): the report's table lists the same seven justices of the peace, elected November 5, 2024 (printing the lister as 'Mo LaVarnway').
